instruction:

Delete rows where color is NULL
output: DELETE FROM cars WHERE color IS NULL;

instruction:

Delete all rows from cars
output: DELETE FROM cars;

instruction:
Schema: cars(id, model, price, color)
Upsert: insert or update on conflict of the id
output: INSERT INTO cars (id, model) VALUES (1, 'X') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET model = EXCLUDED.model;

instruction:
Schema: cars(id, model, price, color)
Conditional update using CASE
output: UPDATE cars SET price = CASE WHEN price > 100 THEN price - 10 ELSE price + 10 END;

instruction:
Schema: cars(id, model, price, color)
Update a join-based target using a subquery value
output: UPDATE cars SET price = (SELECT MAX(price) FROM cars) WHERE price IS NULL;

instruction:
Schema: cars(id, model, price, color)
Delete with a subquery filter
output: DELETE FROM cars WHERE price IN (SELECT price FROM cars WHERE color = 'skip');

instruction:
Schema: cars(id, model, price, color)
Insert with explicit column list and defaults
output: INSERT INTO cars (model, price, color) VALUES ('A', 5, 'active');

instruction:

Update with a LIMIT to only change a few rows
output: UPDATE cars SET price = price + 1 WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM cars LIMIT 5);

Insert ignoring duplicates
